text.p: Note: (1) Net income for both 1995 periods include a loss of $15 million ($.17 per share) related to the impairment of oil and gas properties associated with the adoption of Statement of Financial Accounting Standards No. 121.
Net income for both 1995 periods include a loss of $6.8 million ($0.08 per share) on unrecoverable gas contract realignment costs at Southern Natural.

Net income for both 1995 periods include a loss of $5.5 million ($.06 per share) on natural gas futures contracts that ceased to qualify for accounting as hedges due to the decoupling of the NYMEX futures market for natural gas with the price of natural gas in certain parts of the country.
Net income for 1995 12 month period includes a gain of $110 million ($1.27 per share) related to the sale of the company's remaining shares of Sonat Offshore Drilling.
Net income for 1995 12 month period includes a loss of $20 million ($.23 per share) related to the sale of oil and gas properties.
Net income for the 1995, 12 month period includes a gain of $24 million ($0.28 per share) related to terminations of long-term gas sales contracts.
Net income for the 1995, 12 month period includes a loss of $8 million ($0.09 per share) related to the sale of the company's investment in Baker Hughes Inc convertible preferred stock.
Note: Full company name is Sonat Inc.
